name: Voice of Customer Onboarding
description: Available only through an explicit package install. The Voice of Customer half of the onboarding lifecycle, fully independent of the meta-onboarding package: stages the voc-data-pull and voc-audit skills plus the VoC post-install and activation. Installation only delivers files: before connected-account reads, routine creation, or /agent/user.md changes, the activation discloses those effects and waits for an explicit human yes, offering at most once per conversation for an unrostered workspace (the legacy meta-and-voc-onboarding roster counts as onboarded). The reply that reports a successful install must itself end with that setup offer (see the staged README's After-install section): the installing conversation's system prompt predates the package, so the activation gate cannot fire there on its own. After approval, post-install resolves the workspace only from the conversation's Motion context, creates human-confirmed workspace-scoped daily VoC sync routines (Meta ad comments included when Meta is connected), kicks the 12-month backfills, and records completion in the runneth:voc-onboarded roster. Once a workspace's backfill is fully covered, the sync routine offers a manual Voice of Customer Audit once, deferring while a Meta onboarding is mid-flight; the audit runs only on a person's yes. All generated data is scoped to /agent/brain/<workspace>/data-sources/voc/ so multi-workspace onboarding stays additive.
